metadata.title: Local study of generic dynamical systems on the b-symplectic plane
metadata.abstract: Let $\Gb$ be the group of germs of planar diffeomorphisms, fixing the origin, which preserve the standard b-symplectic form. The group acts on itself, under the usual left-right action and we identify, in the generic case, a simple representative of each orbit, depending on a non-vanishing, univariate, function. We then study the action of $\Gb$ on b-symplectic vector fields. For those fields that do not vanish at the origin, we establish a flow-box type theorem, while, for those that do vanish there, we show that the study of their conjugacy classes reduces to a classification of functions. We present this classification, when the origin is a regular point for these functions, while if it is a critical point, we present the orbits of their 2-jets. Finally, we address the problem of whether an element of $\Gb$ can be realised as the time-1 map of a b-symplectic vector field.
metadata.comment: 23 pages, keywords: b-symplectic plane, classification of dynamical systems

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 局部正规形与可嵌入性
analysis.workSummary: 研究保持标准b辛形式且固定原点的平面微分同胚芽。在一般位置给出由非零一元函数决定的轨道代表。对原点非零的b辛向量场建立流盒型定理，对消失场把共轭分类化为函数分类，给出函数正则点分类及临界点二阶jet轨道，并讨论时间1映射实现问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 把奇异辛平面上的局部动力分类约化为较简单的函数数据。
analysis.limitations: 临界点仅给二阶jet轨道；一般位置及时间1可实现性的全部条件需正文确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文及补充模型名检索未观察到生成式AI使用披露。第15页Astra来自a straight line，实际描述直线与导数的横截条件。

analysis.priorityReason: 偏向局部辛动力系统，几何分析关联较少。
